title: CONDITIONAL WORKLOAD AUTHORITY COURT

epistemic_status.note: The connected GitHub pass did not yield reliable line-level extraction of every requested authority file. Missing source-level authorization is classified as MISSING_AUTHORITY rather than inferred from implementation.

verdict: No demonstrated universal authority licenses every question crossed with all twelve hard-coded V550 INDICATOR_FIELDS. Compute/preserve, structural interpretation, and V3 runtime binding are distinct jurisdictions. Non-bindable empirical conditionals may still be lawfully retained when contextual or future-evidence authority explicitly requires them. An explicit governed workload-selection seam is required for authority-first compilation.

holdings.finding: Hard-coded membership in INDICATOR_FIELDS is not semantic workload authority.
No demonstrated general authority licenses question × all twelve INDICATOR_FIELDS as canonical production workload.
allowed_as_demographic_predictor is diagnostic/exploratory permission standing alone.
allowed_as_branch_splitter is diagnostic/exploratory permission standing alone.
Source-structure, response-topology, weighting, and denominator authority govern availability or computation semantics but do not independently select a conditioner.
A governed dimension-level stratification rule may authorize deterministic expansion across its authoritative value domain; observed values do not self-authorize.
Structural interpretation requires separate explicit authority beyond predictive association or compute permission.
Runtime binding to a generated V3 position requires a separate explicit cross-ontology bridge; shared strings are insufficient.
Contextual/future-authorized empirical evidence may be worth computing or preserving even when no current V3 binding exists.
Authority is not closed under conjunction: A and B separately do not authorize A AND B.
Strong unrequested interactions may remain diagnostic discoveries but cannot self-promote to canonical, structural, or runtime authority.

jurisdictions.compute_preserve: Requires authority over question/measure and conditioner at sufficient granularity plus governed topology/denominator semantics; current V3 bindability is not required when contextual/future retention is authorized.
jurisdictions.structural_interpretation: Requires explicit authority to treat an empirical association as structural evidence; predictive power alone is insufficient.
jurisdictions.runtime_binding: Requires explicit cross-ontology authority from empirical structural evidence to a lawfully generated V3 position.

authority_requested_when_explicitly_gove: instantiate authorized dimension over authoritative value domain
retain support uncertainty and typed absence
retain contextual/future evidence when explicitly authorized
hard_coded_or_unrequested_without_separa: every observed coordinate as production conditioner
every observed value as canonical predicate
predictor/splitter flags promoted to canonical workload

conjunctions.required_authority: Explicit conjunction authority or explicit conjunction-generation law.
conjunctions.v550j_finding: V550J joint-configuration authority cannot be presumed to authorize respondent-condition conjunctions unless its accepted jurisdiction expressly includes them and supplies denominator/support semantics.

diagnostic_may: test unrequested coordinates and interactions under explicit diagnostic regime
retain support uncertainty effect and provenance
diagnostic_may_not: become structural evidence solely from association strength
diagnostic_vs_canonical.promotion_rule: Explicit governing authority must adopt the discovery into a canonical semantic lane.

no_loss_consequences: Preserve explicitly authorized contextual/future conditionals even without current runtime binding.
Retain governed substrate required for exact future reconstruction where retention authority requires it.
Do not compute all possible crossings merely as insurance.
Future authority must either enable exact reconstruction from retained substrate or receive typed unavailability.
Preserve support uncertainty minority weak contradictory and multimodal evidence.
Contextual empirical evidence may remain permanently non-bindable without becoming illegitimate.

primary_question_answers.1: No universal exact enumeration was demonstrated for the full twelve-field crossing.
primary_question_answers.2: Broad dimension/lane permissions do not imply arbitrary fields and values.
primary_question_answers.3: Predictor/splitter flags are diagnostic/exploratory permission, not canonical workload authority standing alone.
primary_question_answers.4: No demonstrated universal license for all twelve fields; hard-coded inclusion is not authority.
primary_question_answers.5: Explicit contextual, historical, structural-without-binding, or future-evidence lanes remain legitimate.
primary_question_answers.6: Conditionals lacking both workload authority and contextual/future retention authority are not mandatory production workload.
primary_question_answers.7: Authority must declare dimension vs exact-predicate granularity; governed dimension rules may instantiate authoritative domains.
primary_question_answers.8: Conjunctions require explicit authority; V550J helps only if its jurisdiction expressly includes respondent-condition conjunctions.
primary_question_answers.9: Strong unrequested interactions may remain diagnostic discoveries with provenance/support/uncertainty but cannot self-promote.
primary_question_answers.10: Minimum object is GOVERNED_CONDITIONAL_WORKLOAD_SPEC with exact scope, conditioner/granularity, topology, weighting/denominator, support/absence, semantic lane, authority refs, and provenance/version/hash.
